findings.evidence: Lines 43–48 distinguish the residue-ring dimensions from `k`-dimension but assert an unconditional equivalence; `subsingleton_irreducibleMorphismSpace_iff` at line 261 explicitly covers the zero-space case.
findings.fix: State this only as a sufficient condition, or add the hypotheses under which the converse is intended.
findings.issue: The module docstring says the base-ring and residue-division-ring arrow counts agree “exactly when” both residue rings are `k`; this is not necessary, for example when `Irr(X,Y)=0`, when all dimensions agree regardless of the residue rings.

findings.evidence: The declarations at lines 314, 320, and 354 are public `@[simp]` interface lemmas, and the implementation notes identify these computations as the abstraction boundary for the opaque quotient representation.
findings.fix: Add short result-oriented docstrings explaining how the radical and quotient equivalences act on representatives.
findings.issue: The public computation lemmas `coe_jacobsonRadicalSubmoduleCongr_apply`, `coe_jacobsonRadicalSubmoduleCongr_symm_apply` (line 320), and `irreducibleMorphismSpaceCongr_mk` (line 354) have no docstrings.

summary: The module is substantially documented, but one dimension claim remains overstated and three public computation lemmas lack docstrings.
